name.zh: 壁报报道一辉击败剑士杀手
name.en: Wall Newspaper Reports Ikki Defeating Sword Eater

periods.summary: Kagami publishes a wall-newspaper article with hidden photos stating that Ikki defeated Donrou's ace Kuraudo outside official matches.
periods.cause: Kagami senses a scoop from Ikki and Ayase's selection-battle conversation and secretly follows the group to the dojo duel.
periods.process: The article frames Ikki as having beaten last year's Seven Stars quarterfinalist and includes detailed photos from the duel.
periods.outcome: Remaining students who doubted Ikki's strength largely fall silent.
periods.aftermath: Campus debate shifts to whether Ikki could rival Hagun's strongest student, Raikiri Toka Todo.
periods.significance: Transforms Ikki's unofficial victory into schoolwide legend and sets up comparisons to Toka.
